funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any stage in their career with a confirmed publisher and a scheduled publication date within three years.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for authors to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles that reflect advanced research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage; higher tiers (£8,001‑£20,000) for post‑doctoral level or equivalent experience.
opportunities.summary: Flexible funding to support research travel and/or time to address specific research questions in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled in or beginning a master’s or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Fixed‑amount grant to help students begin or continue postgraduate studies in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered undergraduate or higher students (UK or international) researching 18th‑19th‑century British works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Fixed‑amount grant to fund travel for research on historical works on paper.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: £32,000 for one year (or split over two years part‑time)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a UK master’s degree in British art, to start between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master’s degree that brings new perspectives to British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: £96,000 total (£32,000 per year for three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a UK doctorate in British art, to start between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding for doctoral research, covering fees and living expenses, to expand understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 for one year or £70,000 for two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Post‑doctoral level individuals (or equivalent experience) seeking to undertake a major research project.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support an in‑depth research project that will reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre‑doctoral to senior level.
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome to conduct advanced research on British‑Italian cultural exchange.
